method: Normalized Hebrew contiguous-token alignment; exact anchors require runs of at least two tokens, with monotonic interpolation between anchors.

qualityOverride.basis: 192 exact contiguous-token anchors span all five canonical transcript segments. Beginning, middle, and ending anchor contexts were inspected; the first exact anchor is at 20.66s and the last at 1837.48s of a 1846.70s recording. Only exact words are seekable, while interpolated words remain visibly distinguished.
